Sales API reference (v2)

Updated 2026-09-30.

List sales

GET /v2/sales returns the sales made at one location between two times. Each sale includes its line items: the product code (SKU), the quantity and the time of sale.

Results are paged, 100 sales to a page. Ask for the next page with the cursor the last response gives you.

Authentication

Every request carries an API key in the Authorization header. Create a key under Settings, then API, and choose the read-only sales scope for reporting tools.

curl https://developer.quillfeather.example.com/v2/sales -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

A key looks like this one, which belongs to our demo shop:

Authorization: Bearer qf_live_7f3a9c2e5b8d4f6a1c0e9b7d3a5f8c2e

Limits

Requests are rate limited per account. See API limits for the numbers.
